tools.name: list_analyses
tools.title: List my analyses
tools.description: List the signed-in user's most recent SonicSIM semantic analyses with their six category scores (emotional, cognitive, social, communication, contextual, artistic), confidence and grounding level.

limit.description: How many analyses to return (1-50, default 10)

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on the source name.

tools.name: get_fingerprint
tools.title: Get my sonic fingerprint
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's aggregate sonic fingerprint: all-time and last-30-day averages across the six SonicSIM categories, how many sources it is based on, and its confidence.

tools.name: list_audio_sources
tools.title: List my audio sources
tools.description: List the signed-in user's audio sources (Spotify/Apple tracks, uploads and ingested signals) with their analysis status, so the caller can see what is analyzed, pending or failed.

limit.description: How many sources to return (1-50, default 15)

tools.name: search_taxonomy
tools.title: Search the ontology taxonomy
tools.description: Search SonicSIM's semantic taxonomy (CTV, IAB, web and AudioSet branches) by label or dotted code, and report how well each node is grounded in real audio.

query.description: Text to match against the node label or code, e.g. 'news' or 'ctv.genre'.

limit.description: How many nodes to return (1-50, default 15)
